title: Mystical Beasts: The Holy Forest (lore build)
summary: The Mystical Beasts of the Forest ("Holy Beasts of the Forest" in Japanese) are EARTH Beasts with plants growing on them. The page calls them a package, not a deck, so this list keeps all seven together with the only other card of their forest, Eco, Mystical Spirit of the Forest, and climbs into Leo, the Keeper of the Sacred Tree and Rank 2 Beast Xyz Monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest (2026) banishes a Beast from your hand or field until the End Phase to Special Summon an EARTH Beast of equal or lower Level from the Deck or GY.
Carpiponica, Mystical Beast of the Forest searches another Mystical Beast or Eco, Mystical Spirit of the Forest when summoned, and returns from the GY to the hand when a Beast is sent to the GY.

Kittytail, Mystical Beast of the Forest sends a Beast, Beast-Warrior, Winged Beast, Insect, or Plant with the same Type as a monster you control from the Deck to the GY, and searches when destroyed by the opponent.
Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest is a Level 2 Beast Tuner that discards a card to revive a Level 2 or lower Beast in Attack or face-down Defense Position.

summary.title: Opening: Cerynemesia + Valerifawn
steps: Summon Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest and banish a Level 2 Beast from your hand or field until the End Phase to Special Summon Carpiponica or Kittytail from the Deck.
Use Carpiponica to search Kalantosa, Mystical Beast of the Forest (or Kittytail to mill Kalantosa or Uniflora into the GY).

Activate Valerifawn, Mystical Beast of the Forest by discarding a card to revive Kalantosa from the GY, triggering Kalantosa to destroy a card on the field, then overlay two Level 2 Beasts into Melffy of the Forest or Number 64: Ronin Raccoon Sandayu.

summary.title: Kalantosa & Uniflora
summary.text: Kalantosa, Mystical Beast of the Forest destroys a card on the field every time it is Special Summoned by the effect of a Beast monster, without once-per-turn limits. Cerynemesia summons it from the Deck or GY, Valerifawn revives it from the GY, and Uniflora, Mystical Beast of the Forest tributes itself while all monsters in your GY are Beasts to summon Kalantosa or Level 7 Alpacaribou from the hand or GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Leo, the Keeper of the Sacred Tree, the Level 10 EARTH Beast Synchro the page names as Uniflora's classic partner, is made from Level 7 Alpacaribou + Level 2 Tuner Valerifawn + Level 1 Uniflora, and cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects outside Main Phase 2.

Number 64: Ronin Raccoon Sandayu, made from any two Level 2 Mystical Beasts, detaches to summon a Kagemusha Raccoon Token matching the highest ATK on the field and cannot be destroyed while another Beast is out.
Melffy of the Forest detaches to search a Melffy card and negates an opposing monster's effects when a Beast returns to the hand.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: All seven Mystical Beasts of the Forest, led by Cerynemesia (2026) and Kittytail (2023), plus Alpacaribou protecting Winged Beasts, Insects, and Plants.
Eco, Mystical Spirit of the Forest, released alongside Uniflora in 2012 and searchable by Carpiponica, summons itself from the hand on effect damage and reflects it back.
Remaining Main Deck slots use handtraps and staple Spells since the forest package has no archetypal Spells or Traps of its own.
